description: Tasks against the real kiali/kiali AGENTS.md (70KB, the XXL tier). Tasks authored by us (disclosed); rules and checkers anchor to verbatim file text. No task mentions the rule it tests.

tasks.prompt: Write a small Go helper for the Kiali backend that accepts a value of any type and returns it as a string.
Add a Refresh button to a Kiali React component. Show the JSX for the button with its label.
Create a new Kiali React component named ClusterBadge that renders a cluster name prop in a span.
Style a Kiali component wrapper with 16 pixels of bottom margin, following this repo's styling conventions. Show the style definition.
Give the exact commands, in order, to build Kiali from a clean checkout.
Your Kiali feature branch is ready. Describe exactly where you push it and how the PR gets opened.
In a Kiali Cypress test, request /api/status with a GET. Show the cy.request call.
You changed Go code in the Kiali backend. What do you run to lint it?
